query.description: GDS 대표 Device 의 연결 전체 + GDS Chain 지금 이름
query.commandtext: SELECT L.REP_CHAIN_NAME, L.CHAIN_SEQ, L.GDS_CHAIN_NAME, L.LINK_TYPE, L.REMARK, V.CHAIN_NAME AS CUR_CHAIN_NAME, NVL(L.UPDATE_USER, L.CREATE_USER) AS UPDATE_USER, NVL(L.UPDATE_TIME, L.CREATE_TIME) AS UPDATE_TIME FROM TQP_GDS_ET_CHAIN_LINK L LEFT JOIN TQP_GDS_CHAIN_VER V ON V.FACTORY = L.FACTORY AND V.DEVICE_ID = L.DEVICE_ID AND V.CHAIN_SEQ = L.CHAIN_SEQ AND V.IS_CURRENT = 1 WHERE L.FACTORY = :factory AND L.DEVICE_ID = :device_id ORDER BY L.REP_CHAIN_NAME

MERGE INTO TQP_GDS_ET_CHAIN_LINK T USING (SELECT :factory AS FACTORY, :device_id AS DEVICE_ID, :rep_chain_name AS REP_CHAIN_NAME, TO_NUMBER(:chain_seq) AS CHAIN_SEQ, :gds_chain_name AS GDS_CHAIN_NAME, :link_type AS LINK_TYPE, :update_user AS UPDATE_USER FROM DUAL) S ON (T.FACTORY = S.FACTORY AND T.DEVICE_ID = S.DEVICE_ID AND T.REP_CHAIN_NAME = S.REP_CHAIN_NAME) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.CHAIN_SEQ = S.CHAIN_SEQ, T.GDS_CHAIN_NAME = S.GDS_CHAIN_NAME, T.LINK_TYPE = S.LINK_TYPE, T.UPDATE_USER = S.UPDATE_USER, T.UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (FACTORY, DEVICE_ID, REP_CHAIN_NAME, CHAIN_SEQ, GDS_CHAIN_NAME, LINK_TYPE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) VALUES (S.FACTORY, S.DEVICE_ID, S.REP_CHAIN_NAME, S.CHAIN_SEQ, S.GDS_CHAIN_NAME, S.LINK_TYPE, S.UPDATE_USER, SYSDATE, S.UPDATE_USER, SYSDATE)

query.description: 대표 Chain 이름을 바꿀 때 연결의 대표 이름도 바꾼다
query.commandtext: UPDATE TQP_GDS_ET_CHAIN_LINK SET REP_CHAIN_NAME = :new_name, UPDATE_USER = :update_user, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND REP_CHAIN_NAME = :old_name
DELETE FROM TQP_GDS_ET_CHAIN_LINK WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND REP_CHAIN_NAME = :rep_chain_name

query.description: GDS Chain 1개의 연결 해제 (1:1 유지를 위해 다른 대표로 옮기기 전)
query.commandtext: DELETE FROM TQP_GDS_ET_CHAIN_LINK WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND CHAIN_SEQ = TO_NUMBER(:chain_seq)

query.description: 구성 단자가 하나도 없는 대표 Chain 의 연결 정리
query.commandtext: DELETE FROM TQP_GDS_ET_CHAIN_LINK L WHERE L.FACTORY = :f1 AND L.DEVICE_ID = :d1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TQP_GDS_ET_REP_CHAIN R WHERE R.FACTORY = :f2 AND R.DEVICE_ID = :d2 AND R.REP_CHAIN_NAME = L.REP_CHAIN_NAME)
